source.text:
Claude Ultra $200 可以使用的额度

- 只用 Opus 5.5 可以使用 $15000 左右
- 先用一半 Fable 5.2 ($3000) 额度，再用Opus 5.5 总共可以使用 $10000 左右
- Fable 5.2 可以使用 $3000 左右
- Fable 5.1 只能使用 $2000 左右

Fable 5.2 比 Fable 5.1 速度快，价格还便宜

screenshot.title: What $200 of Claude Ultra gets you
screenshot.subtitlePrinted: A month of only Opus 5.5 is worth $14,662 at API prices. Fable has its own limit, and it is half of each week. Use Fable 5.2 first and the month is worth $10,353.
screenshot.measurementPrinted: measured from 1.1M proxied requests, Aug 11 to Nov 9, 2026
screenshot.monthConventionPrinted: One month is 30 days, which is 4.3 weekly limits. One week of only Opus 5.5 is worth $3,421.
screenshot.monthWorthIsWeeklyScaled: 图把月值写成 30 天、约 4.3 个周上限；Opus-only 的周值 $3,421 乘 30/7 才落到月值 $14,662。这不是五个情景各自独立实测的单月耗尽额度。
